title: Türkiye Reports 552 Border Apprehensions and 95 kg of Drugs Seized in One Week
excerpt: Türkiye's defence ministry says 552 people, three of them members of terrorist organisations, were caught at the borders in a week, with about 95 kg of drugs seized.
rank_math_title: Türkiye: 552 caught at borders in a week | Envanter Medya
rank_math_description: Türkiye's defence ministry weekly figures: 552 people caught at the borders, 3,275 prevented from crossing and about 95 kg of drugs seized in Van and Hakkâri.
